evidence.excerpt: Revnu is now live on @ycombinator The future means anyone can run a business never having to worry about growth again Check us out at http:// revnu.com Quote Y Combinator @ycombinator · May 21 Revnu (@revnu_app) makes growth a solved problem. With AI now anyone can build a product, but with Revnu anyone can sell it. You never have to hire a growth person again. Technical teams focus on building, while Revnu handles the rest. Congrats on the launch, @artfreebrey &
